verdict.rationale: Loops has dynamic segments in the product, but its documented API, MCP server, and CLI cover contacts, mailing lists, events, transactional email, campaigns, content, themes, and workflows, not creating or defining segments. Mailing-list management and contact properties are adjacent building blocks, not a programmatic way to turn an audience description into a segment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface
